name: Through the Plans: Pheonix's Tear
source:
'Phoenix's Tear is a short visual novel game about a ghost who, thanks to a marvel of technology, gets his body back. Follow William's steps in this little delirium.'

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230722052518/https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/pheonix-tear]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《凤凰之泪》是一款短篇视觉小说游戏，讲述了一个鬼魂凭借一项奇迹般的技术恢复了自己的身体的故事。在这个小小的疯狂中跟随威廉的脚步。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230722052518/https://yellow-chocobo.itch.io/pheonix-tear]Itch.io[/url]]
